people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Jacob asked him, “Please tell me your name.” He said, “Why is it that you ask what my name is?” He blessed him there.
translations.bsb: And Jacob requested, “Please tell me your name.” But he replied, “Why do you ask my name?” Then he blessed Jacob there.
